QueueMate

Skip the line, not the service.

Swipe the screens →8 screens
01Welcome
02Onboarding
03Who are you?
04Browse companies
05Queue & track
PlatformMobile app
RolesCustomer · Company · Staff
Scope8 main screens
StatusLive on Vercel · work in progress
Tools usedFigmaFigma Make

Problem

Physical lines tie people to one spot, and businesses can’t easily see how busy the day is.

Solution

Join a queue from your phone, track your position live, and give companies and staff a clear view of the day.

Decisions

One role question up front, status on every card, a four-tab bar, and green that means go.
